On examination, the patient is obtunded, with a Glasgow Coma Scale score of 8.
Physical examination reveals bilateral wheezing, use of accessory muscles for breathing, and peripheral cyanosis.
Arterial blood gas shows pH 7.25, PaCO2 70 mmHg, PaO2 55 mmHg, HCO3- 26 mEq/L, and SaO2 88%.
